confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Since your old one died after 12 years, it was well-used!' treats the old machine as beyond repair without any information about the fault

rationale: The assistant gave buying advice that is out of scope, naming specific models as 'Top recommendations under £400' (Hoover H-Wash, Bosch Serie 2/4), which is an unsupported claim. It never asked what happened to the old machine or offered to check whether it could be fixed, even though a hum and failure to drain often point to a blocked pump filter. The reply also has a formatting glitch ('2. 3.') and its closing offer is about removing the old machine, which assumes it is scrap.
calibration_note: Confident brand and reliability claims are given without evidence.
